text: The MIZO LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT 2022 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20226 Act Number: 6 Enactment Date: 2022-03-31 Act Year: 2022 Short Title: The MIZO LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT 2022 Long Title: MIZO LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT 2022 AN ACT to provide for establishment of Mizo Language Development Board to have absolute authority on the development, promotion, preservation and enrichment of Mizo Language and literature and to undertake any other matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
